notes.title: FAQ for racing game R9W.
notes.content:
Hello to all Path Racers!

In this article we tried to answer the main questions about the game, our plans and future development.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683645/3beba5aeb26a66801ba7116ec86a801aa18abcf9.png"]

1. About the Game


Q: What’s this game about? 
A: A dynamic arcade racer with adventure elements, inspired by classic racing games and 2000s sci-fi cartoons. Players compete in interplanetary races for control of the universe, using unique vehicles and magical abilities. 


Q: Target audience? 
A: Arcade racing fans, sci-fi lovers, and all-age players (E rating). 

2. Gameplay & Features  

Q: What makes this racing game unique? 
A: Blends arcade racing with deep character stories, interactive tracks (Serpent Seals),  and a narrative-driven campaign.  

Q: What are Serpent Seals? 
A: Track objects that dynamically alter races (speed boosts/obstacles).


Q: How does gameplay work? 
A: Races span diverse planets. Players drift, boost, and use racer-specific abilities (tactical arcade-style).


Q: How many racers/tracks? 
A: Launch: 9 racers, each with unique vehicles/abilities/storylines. Tracks are grouped into biomes (3–5 per biome: cities, deserts, icy wastes, etc.). 


Q: Multiplayer? 
A: Now, the local split-screen mode (for 2 players) is available, and the full online mode is in development. 


Q: Controller support? 
A: Xbox gamepads supported. No wheel support (vehicles are too diverse).  


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683645/0ff88c6ad5a343dd7d165251105c24a9907af739.png"]
3. Story & World


Q: Who is Balt? 
A: The fox-like alien protagonist from the Rinki tribe, racing to change the universe’s fate. 


Q: What’s the story? 
A: Balt’s journey across nine worlds, facing rivals and unraveling the Great Serpent’s motives.



Q: Player choices? 
A: Linear campaign, but relationships with racers unlock rewards/lore. 

4. Technical features
Q: Platforms? 
A: PC (Steam) first, consoles later. 


Q: System requirements? 
A: Minimum:

OS: Win 10 (64-bit)

CPU: Ryzen 5 2600 / i5-8400

GPU: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 570

RAM: 8 GB

Storage: 6 GB

Recommended:

CPU: Ryzen 7 5800X / i5-10600

GPU: RTX 2060 Super / RX 5700 XT

RAM: 16 GB
5. Release & Support 

Q: Release date? 
A: TBA (early production, seeking investors/publishers). 


Q: Post-launch plans?
A: New tracks, racers, and stories planned (model TBD). 


Q: How to follow updates? 
A: Our socials:  X - 

https://x.com/OuroborosStd

 Discord - 

https://discord.gg/x2ry7f4B

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683645/83a383349c6a071e8e97841dc0efed040b39553e.jpg"]

Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlists this fall, we want to conduct a playtest among everyone who adds the game to their wishlist.

We'll be glad to see you on the track!
